statement: You are given heights, a grid where heights[r][c] is the height of cell (r, c). You start at the top-left cell (0, 0) and want to reach the bottom-right cell, moving one cell up, down, left or right at a time.
The effort of a route is the largest absolute difference in height between two consecutive cells along it.
Return the minimum effort over all routes from the top-left to the bottom-right cell.

examples.explanation: The route 1 → 3 → 5 → 3 → 5 down the left side and along the bottom never changes height by more than 2. Every route has some step of at least 2, so 2 is the minimum.
Going along the top and down the right side, 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5, every step changes height by exactly 1.
